Archer's Global Footprint The Archer community reflects our commitment to partnership and innovation, ensuring organizations everywhere have the expertise and tools needed to thrive in an increasingly complex world. Archer serves 1,200+ clients across 48 countries globally, supporting compliance and risk management programs in financial services, healthcare, technology, government, and beyond. Archer Leadership Bill Diaz Chief Executive Officer Bill brings more than 20 years of risk management experience, leading Archer’s mission to deliver solutions that help customers realize measurable value and achieve their strategic goals. His leadership drives innovation, client success, and builds a culture of excellence across the company. Rishi Roy Chief Transformation Officer With over 20 years of experience leading digital and operational transformations in SaaS and financial services, Rishi drives cross-functional programs, operational excellence, and strategic initiatives that enhance Archer's ability to serve clients and execute on its vision. Kevin Bobowski Chief Marketing Officer Bringing 20 years of experience to his role as Chief Marketing Officer, Kevin is recognized for his expertise in scaling marketing organizations, driving brand growth, and delivering measurable results across global markets. Jeff Longoria Chief Commercial Officer With more than 25 years of technology sector leadership, Jeff drives go-to-market strategy, sales, marketing, and customer success initiatives. His proven track record in accelerating growth and building high-performing teams enables Archer to deliver exceptional value to clients worldwide. Kayvan Alikhani Chief Product & Technology Officer With extensive experience in security, mobile identity, and cloud-based solutions, Kayvan leads the development of next-generation capabilities that keep clients ahead of evolving risks. He drives innovation by leveraging emerging technologies to address complex compliance and risk management challenges. Rosemary Haefner Chief Human Resources Officer Rosemary brings over 20 years of CHRO experience operating in PE-backed high-growth environments, aligning people, culture, and talent strategy with business outcomes. Bill Razzino Chief Financial Officer Bill brings more than 25 years of experience scaling SaaS businesses through strategic financial leadership. As CFO, he ensures scalable processes that drive value for clients, employees, and investors while positioning Archer for continued growth. Mike Ostendorf Chief Global Services Officer Mike brings more than 18 years of expertise in services-oriented software and integrated risk management. His focus on client outcomes ensures successful implementations and long-term value realization. Matt Sherrill General Counsel With over 20 years of law firm and in-house legal experience, Matt leads Archer's worldwide Legal team. He provides strategic counsel to ensure the company operates with integrity and excellence across all jurisdictions. Ready to get started?
